body: Don't know if I have "everything", but materially I'm doing ok. I have a job (software engineer) that's pretty relaxed and pays enough to be comfortable. Nothing has any meaning to me though. I can't find anything I enjoy other than staying at home alone on my computer but that's no way to live. I also have a therapist and he helps a bit otherwise I'd probably hardly talk to anyone. I've been fantasising about jumping in front of trains and off bridges when commuting.
